The house

A whole house, all to yourselves

Meteora Horizon is a traditional detached house in the centre of Kalampaka, on Platanos Square, at the foot of the Meteora rocks. It sleeps up to 8 guests in two bedrooms and a living room, has a full kitchen, one bathroom, a veranda and free parking outside. Built in 1954, renovated in 2020, and run by its owners, Giannis and Dimitra, who live in town.

Its story

Built with care, in 1954

This house was built in 1954 by Evangelos Ntziafas, a policeman, and his beloved wife Mary Albani, a dressmaker — with great care and many hardships, while they raised their three daughters.

In January 2020 it was renovated from top to bottom, keeping its character: the high ceilings, the old photographs, the chandeliers, the veranda over the square. Today it welcomes travellers from all over the world, and the frame with their story still hangs in the living room.

A day here

From your door to the monasteries

Scroll and watch the light change over the rocks — just as you will see it from the veranda.

07:30

Coffee on the veranda

The first light reaches the rocks above the roof. Bakery, fruit and the supermarket are a minute's walk. On Fridays the farmers' market sets up right outside the house.

09:00

The trail starts nearby

For those who like walking, the path up to the monasteries starts a few minutes from the house. The church of the Dormition (Kimisi Theotokou) is 400 m away.

12:00

Monasteries on the rocks

By car the monastic complex of Meteora is a few minutes away: Agios Nikolaos Anapafsas at 2.9 km, Roussanou at 4.5 km.

15:00

Lunch in town, a walk, a nap

Cafés start 200 m away and tavernas a short stroll further. Back home for an afternoon rest under the high ceilings.

19:30

Sunset over the rocks

The rocks turn gold, then pink. Hiking, cycling and horse riding are all around for the next day.

22:00

The rock lit above the house

At night the rock above the house is floodlit — the view in the photo at the top of this page, from your own doorstep.

All year round

Every season, a different Meteora

At Christmas the house is decorated, with the tree on the veranda, and snow turns the town and the rocks white. Inside it stays warm, with heating and hot water.

The trails turn green and fill with flowers. On Friday mornings the farmers' market sets up right outside the house — fruit and vegetables from local producers.

Long days up at the monasteries, and evenings watching the sun go down behind the rocks.

The forests turn gold and red, and on cool mornings the mist rises between the rocks. The best time for long walks on the trails.

How many people does the house sleep?

Up to 8. Bedroom 1 has three single beds, bedroom 2 has a king-size bed and a sofa bed, and the living room has two sofa beds. There is one bathroom, and a cot for babies up to 2 years old, free of charge.

Is there parking?

Yes, free, on the street right outside the house. On Friday mornings the farmers' market sets up in front of the house, so if you arrive on a Thursday ask us where best to leave the car overnight.

How far are the Meteora monasteries?

The walking path up to the monasteries starts a few minutes from the house. By car, Agios Nikolaos Anapafsas Monastery is 2.9 km away and Roussanou Monastery 4.5 km.

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out until 11:00. You let yourselves in with a key lockbox, so you can arrive at any hour — just tell us roughly when.

Can I come without a car?

Yes. Kalampaka railway station is 700 m away and the bus station is a few minutes on foot. Shops, cafés and tavernas are all within walking distance.

Is the house good in winter?

Yes. The house is warm, with heating, air conditioning and hot water all year round — guests have stayed for whole weeks in January.

Are pets allowed?

Yes, on request: up to 2 pets, at €20 per pet per night.

How do I book?

Send us your dates directly by WhatsApp, e-mail or phone using the form below, and we will reply with availability and the price. You can also book through Booking.com or Airbnb.
